videos.subtitle_summary:
The user wants a summary of a YouTube video transcript in Korean, around 500 characters, with 3-5 sentences. The video is about Goldman Sachs predicting the KOSPI could reach 12,000 points, calling it a "conservative" forecast.
Key points from the transcript:
1. Goldman Sachs predicted KOSPI 12,000 (conservative estimate)
2. Main drivers: Foreign capital inflow, semiconductor supercycle (HBM leadership by Samsung/SK Hynix), Value-up policy (share buybacks, dividends reducing Korea Discount)
3. Positive factors: OECD upgraded Korea's growth forecast (1.7% to 2.6%), trade surplus stable, favorable exchange rate, credit rating upgrades (LG Electronics)
4. Earnings estimates rising faster than stock prices
5. AI infrastructure investment (Nvidia considering Korea tech center)
6. Risks: Global interest rates, US big tech earnings, China recovery
7. Conclusion: World view on Korean market is changing
